title: Establishment of rents
requirement: Rent increases can only take effect at the expiration or termination of a lease or periodic lease, and any increase exceeding authorized chapter provisions is void.
coverage_conditions: dwellings to which this chapter is applicable
quoted_span: Any rental increase at a time other than at the expiration of a lease or termination of the periodic lease shall be void.

title: Controls; increase restrictions; disclosure statement
requirement: All rents are controlled at the October 1, 1985 base rent level, and landlords must provide tenants written notice at least 30 days prior to any rent increase explaining the reason in detail.
coverage_conditions: dwellings to which this act is applicable
quoted_span: All rents for rental of housing space and services in dwellings to which this act is applicable are hereby controlled at the base rent level received by the landlord as of October 1, 1985, and no rental increases shall be hereinafter demanded, paid or accepted, except as provided in this chapter.

title: Expiration or termination of lease
requirement: Landlords may not request or receive a percentage rent increase greater than 5% or the percentage difference in the consumer price index between three months prior to lease expiration and three months prior to lease commencement, whichever is less.
quoted_span: At the expiration of a lease or at the termination of a lease of a periodic tenant, no landlord may request or receive a percentage increase in rent which is greater than 5% or the percentage difference between the consumer price index three months prior to the expiration or termination of the lease and three months prior to the commencement of the lease term, whichever is less.

title: Section 155-10
requirement: Landlords must obtain Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board approval before imposing a capital improvement rent surcharge, and base rents shall under no circumstances be increased by an amount greater than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any one twelve-month period.
quoted_span: it being the intent of this chapter that the base rents shall under no circumstances be increased by an amount greater than 33 1/3% due to a capital improvement surcharge in any one twelve-month period.

title: Section 155-14
requirement: Landlords who cannot meet operating expenses or do not make a fair return on investment may appeal to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a hardship rental increase, provided they obtain prior Board approval and serve notice to each tenant at least 20 days before the hearing.
quoted_span: In the event that a landlord cannot meet his operating expenses or does not make a fair return on his investment, he may appeal to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a hardship rental increase.

title: Section 155-15
requirement: Tenants may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a decrease in rent when services, care, or maintenance decline in any dwelling, after serving notice on the landlord and allowing at least 20 days to elapse before a hearing.
quoted_span: When services, care or maintenance decline in any dwelling, any tenant may apply to the Rent Leveling and Stabilization Board for a decrease in rent.
